title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD remains under pressure near $63 ahead of Fed’s policy decision
summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is marginally lower to near $63.14 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The white metal remains under pressure as investors shift their focus to the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.
